episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Despite opposition from his family, Sa Hye Joon hustles to make ends meet while pursuing an acting career. At a fashion show, he meets Ahn Jung Ha.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Nothing is easy for Hye Joon as he faces an insulting proposition, upsetting clashes with his father and disappointing news from Won Hae Hyo.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Down about work and life, Hye Joon and Jung Ha cheer each other up. Kim Yi Young and Han Ae Sook disagree on what a parent's duty is to their children.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Hye Joon decides to give his acting career one last chance. Over dinner and drinks, Jung Ha spills her heart out to him about trouble at work.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: When Sa Kyung Joon says he wants to move out, Ae Sook calls a family meeting. On the set of the film, Hye Joon puts forth his best effort.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Just when everything seems to be working out, Lee Min Jae runs into a roadblock. Hye Joon and his friends help Sa Min Gi create a modeling portfolio.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Min Jae secures Hye Joon a new audition for a TV drama role. Kyung Joon is stunned when his move doesn't go according to plan.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: As Hye Joon's drama debuts to great success, some in his family are happier than others. Meanwhile, Jung Ha's conflict with her co-worker escalates.
